one_liner: Plaid is a broad REST financial data API with free Sandbox, a free Trial plan for new US/CA teams, and pay-as-you-go production access after approval.
auth_notes: The core Plaid API authenticates with client_id and secret from the Dashboard. Users link accounts through Plaid Link and get per-Item access_tokens. OAuth2 client_credentials via /oauth/token is documented for the Dashboard MCP server. The evidence gives no explicit auth snippet for the core API, so that part rests on background knowledge and is lower confidence.
access_notes: Sandbox is always free. New US/CA teams created on or after 2026-04-15 get an auto-approved free Trial plan with real data and up to 10 Production Items. Full Production needs approval (a few business days) and is pay-as-you-go. EU/UK customers are Custom plans only.
blocker_notes: Sandbox and the Trial plan are self-serve. Scaling to real users needs Production approval, which asks for company and use-case information. Each end user must also complete Plaid Link.
